H2585G.name: Enoch
H2585G.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H2585G.brief: Son of Cain, and a city named after him.
H2585G.short: Enoch was the son of Cain, and Cain built a city and named it after him.

H2585H.name: Enoch
H2585H.desc: Man living at the time before the Flood
H2585H.brief: A righteous man who walked with God.
H2585H.short: Enoch, the son of Jared, walked with God and was taken by Him without experiencing death.

H2526G.name: Ham
H2526G.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2526G.brief: One of Noah's three sons, father of Canaan.
H2526G.short: Ham, one of Noah's three sons, was the father of Canaan and the ancestor of various nations.

H2577.name: Hamathites
H2577.brief: A Canaanite people group descended from Canaan.
H2577.short: The Hamathites were a Canaanite people group descended from Canaan, son of Ham.

H2575B.name: Hammath
H2575B.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2575B.brief: A Kenite clan, descendants of Salma.
H2575B.short: Hammath was a Kenite clan, listed among the descendants of Salma, the  father (ie founder) of Bethlehem.

H2536.name: Hammuel
H2536.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2536.brief: Son of Mishma, a descendant of Simeon.
H2536.short: Hammuel, a descendant of Simeon, was the son of Mishma.

H2544.name: Hamor
H2544.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2544.brief: A Hivite prince, father of Shechem.
H2544.short: Hamor, a Hivite prince, was the father and founder of Shechem and negotiated with Jacob's sons after Shechem's assault on Dinah.

H2538.name: Hamul
H2538.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2538.brief: Son of Perez, grandson of Judah.
H2538.short: Hamul was a son of Perez and a grandson of Judah, mentioned in the genealogies of Genesis, Numbers, and 1 Chronicles.

H2537.name: Hamutal
H2537.desc: Woman living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2537.brief: Mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah, kings of Judah.
H2537.short: Hamutal, the daughter of Jeremiah of Libnah, was the mother of Jehoahaz and Zedekiah, two kings of Judah.

H2584.name: Hannah
H2584.desc: Woman living at the time of United Monarchy
H2584.brief: The mother of the prophet Samuel.
H2584.short: Hannah, the wife of Elkanah, was the mother of the prophet Samuel, whom she dedicated to the Lord's service at a young age.

H2592H.name: Hanniel
H2592H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2592H.brief: A descendant of Asher, son of Ulla.
H2592H.short: Hanniel, a descendant of Asher, was the son of Ulla, as mentioned in the genealogy of the tribe of Asher.

H2592G.name: Hanniel
H2592G.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2592G.brief: The leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the land allotment.
H2592G.short: Hanniel, the son of Ephod, was the leader of the tribe of Manasseh during the allotment of the Promised Land.

H2585I.name: Hanoch
H2585I.desc: Man living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2585I.brief: A son of Midian, grandson of Abraham.
H2585I.short: Hanoch was one of the sons of Midian, a grandson of Abraham through his concubine Keturah.

H2585J.name: Hanoch
H2585J.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2585J.brief: A son of Reuben, grandson of Jacob.
H2585J.short: Hanoch was one of the sons of Reuben, Jacob's firstborn, and a grandson of Jacob.

H2586G.name: Hanun
H2586G.desc: King living at the time of United Monarchy
H2586G.brief: An Ammonite king who mistreated David's envoys.
H2586G.short: Hanun, the Ammonite king, mistreated David's envoys, leading to a war between the Ammonites and Israel.

H2586H.name: Hanun
H2586H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2586H.brief: One of the repairers of the Valley Gate in Jerusalem.
H2586H.short: Hanun, along with the inhabitants of Zanoah, repaired the Valley Gate during the rebuilding of Jerusalem's walls under Nehemiah's leadership.

H2586I.name: Hanun
H2586I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2586I.brief: Another repairer of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's time.
H2586I.short: Hanun, the sixth son of Zalaph, repaired another section of Jerusalem's wall during Nehemiah's rebuilding project.

H2507.name: Helek
H2507.desc: Man living at the time of Egypt and Wilderness
H2507.brief: Son of Gilead, ancestor of the Helekites.
H2507.short: Helek was a son of Gilead and ancestor of the Helekite clan in the tribe of Manasseh.

H2503H.name: Helez
H2503H.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2503H.brief: A descendant of Jerahmeel from the tribe of Judah.
H2503H.short: Helez was a descendant of Jerahmeel, son of Hezron, from the tribe of Judah.

H2503G.name: Helez
H2503G.desc: Warrior living at the time of United Monarchy
H2503G.brief: One of David's mighty warriors from Pelet.
H2503G.short: Helez the Paltite (or Pelonite) was one of David's mighty warriors and commander of his army division for the seventh month.

H2517.name: Helkai
H2517.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2517.brief: A priest during the time of Joiakim.
H2517.short: Helkai was a priest who served during the time of Joiakim the high priest.

H2533.name: Hemdan
H2533.desc: Edomite living at the time of the Patriarchs
H2533.brief: A descendant of Seir the Horite.
H2533.short: Hemdan was a descendant of Seir the Horite, mentioned in the genealogies of Esau.

H2582G.name: Henadad
H2582G.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2582G.brief: A Levite whose sons assisted in rebuilding the temple.
H2582G.short: Henadad was a Levite whose descendants helped rebuild the temple and signed the covenant during Nehemiah's time.

H2582H.name: Henadad
H2582H.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2582H.brief: Son of Binnui, a Levite who repaired the wall.
H2582H.short: Henadad, son of Binnui, was a Levite who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem.

H2582I.name: Henadad
H2582I.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2582I.brief: Son of Bani, a Levite who repaired the wall.
H2582I.short: Henadad, son of Bani, was a Levite who repaired a section of the wall of Jerusalem.

H2518J.name: Hilkiah
H2518J.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2518J.brief: A Levite gatekeeper during David's reign.
H2518J.short: Hilkiah was a Levite who served as a gatekeeper in the tabernacle during the reign of King David.

H2518I.name: Hilkiah
H2518I.desc: Levite living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2518I.short: Hilkiah was a Levite from the family of Merari, mentioned in the genealogy of the Levites.

H2518G.name: Hilkiah
H2518G.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2518G.brief: An official during King Hezekiah's reign.
H2518G.short: Hilkiah served as a high-ranking official in the court of King Hezekiah of Judah.

H2518H.name: Hilkiah
H2518H.desc: High Priest living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2518H.brief: The high priest who discovered the Book of the Law.
H2518H.short: Hilkiah, the high priest during King Josiah's reign, discovered the Book of the Law in the temple, sparking a religious reform.

H2518M.name: Hilkiah
H2518M.desc: Man living at the time of Divided Monarchy
H2518M.brief: The father of the prophet Jeremiah.
H2518M.short: Hilkiah, a priest from Anathoth, was the father of the prophet Jeremiah.

H2518L.name: Hilkiah
H2518L.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2518L.brief: A priest who returned from Babylonian exile.
H2518L.short: Hilkiah was among the priests who returned to Jerusalem from Babylonian captivity and served during the high priesthood of Jeshua and Joiakim.

H2518K.name: Hilkiah
H2518K.desc: Man living at the time of Exile and Return
H2518K.short: Hilkiah was one of the priests who stood beside Ezra when he read the Book of the Law to the people.

H2510.name: Halak Mount
H2510.brief: A mountain marking the southern boundary of Joshua's conquests.
H2510.short: Mount Halak was a mountain that marked the southern boundary of the territory conquered by Joshua (<ref="Joshua 11:17; 12:7">Joshua 11:17; 12:7</ref>).

H2574G.name: Hamath
H2574G.brief: A major city and kingdom in Syria, often mentioned in the Bible.
H2574G.short: Hamath, also known as Hamath Rabbah or Lebo-hamath, was a significant city and kingdom in Syria, frequently mentioned in the Bible as a reference point for the northern border of Israel and in the context of political and military events (<ref="Num.13:21; Judges 3:3; 2Ki.14.25, 28; Jeremiah 39:5; 49:23; 52:9, 27">Num.13:21; Judges 3:3; 2Ki.14.25, 28; Jeremiah 39:5; 49:23; 52:9, 27</ref>).

H2575A.name: Hammath
H2575A.brief: A fortified city and Levitical town in Naphtali.
H2575A.short: Hammath, also known as Hammoth-dor or Hammon, was a fortified city in Naphtali allotted to the Levites (<ref="Joshua 19:35; 21:32; 19:28; 1Ch.6.76">Joshua 19:35; 21:32; 19:28; 1Ch.6.76</ref>).

H2501.name: Heleph
H2501.short: Heleph was a town marking the border of the territory allocated to the tribe of Naphtali (<ref="Josh 19:33">Josh 19:33</ref>).

H2520.name: Helkath
H2520.brief: Levitical city in the territory of Asher
H2520.short: Helkath (or Hukok) was a city allocated to the Levites within the territory of the tribe of Asher (<ref="Josh 19:25; 21:31; 1Ch.6.75">Josh 19:25; 21:31; 1Ch.6.75</ref>).

H2521.name: Helkath-hazzurim
H2521.brief: Site of a battle between David's and Ish-bosheth's men
H2521.short: Helkath-hazzurim, meaning "Field of Swords," was the site of a battle between David's men and those of Ish-bosheth, resulting in Abner's defeat (<ref="2Sa.2.16">2Sa.2.16</ref>).

H2547.name: Humtah
H2547.brief: A town in the hill country of Judah
H2547.short: Humtah, a town in the hill country of Judah (<ref="Joshua 15:54">Joshua 15:54</ref>).
